verdict: Paid ads remain paused; setup milestones are being resolved to unlock launch.
narrative: No paid spend ran on Meta or Google this period, meaning zero paid leads were generated over the last 28 days. Your Google Business Profile stayed active — 83 impressions and 56 direction-clicks over 22 days — but zero calls were recorded, a gap in the listing that is being investigated and corrected. Website sessions also softened late in the period, down roughly 26% in the most recent days compared to the week prior. The focus right now is clearing a set of overdue setup milestones — including conversion tracking, landing pages, and creative — that must be in place before paid campaigns can go live. Once those are confirmed complete, paid channels will move into active spend and the pipeline will begin generating leads.
